messages.msg: Q17 proves on FreePasses that setPending(pending + 1), await delay, setPending(pending - 1) ends at -1, and that updaters end at 0, also after two fast clicks. Q17 uses it only for which value the setter reads. Q75 can reuse the same Pending counter to show how React batches the setter calls after the await. Note: in a jsdom sandbox, two clicks dispatched in one task render together; put a microtask between them to stand for two user clicks.

messages.msg: Q17 proves on TicketOrder, in Chrome, that an async Buy handler with setPending(pending + 1), await sendOrder(), then setPending(pending - 1) and setCompleted(completed + 1) ends at "Pending: -1, Completed: 1" after one Buy, and at "Pending: 0, Completed: 1" after two quick Buys, while updaters end at "Pending: 0, Completed: 2". Q17 uses it only for which value the setter reads. Q75 can reuse the same Buy counter to show how React batches the setter calls after the await. sendOrder is a helper that resolves after one second.
